summary.intent: Complete and ship phase 43 (fuse-write-durability): run a CodeRabbit review, cross-check and fix the 8 criticals from the existing 43-REVIEW.md, run /simplify on the Rust diff, capture deferred follow-ups as todos, and open a PR.
summary.outcome: All 8 criticals resolved (CR-03 TEE-key fallback fixed across all 8 journal wrap sites; CR-04 in-memory mutations deferred past journal fsync on both fuser and winfsp paths). /simplify applied 3 safe cleanups. 6 deferred refactors captured as todos. PR #487 opened and pushed. sync/mod.rs edge-trigger logic extracted into a pure testable function with 8 unit tests. Rust crate codecov wiring added to ci.yml and codecov.yml.

repo: After `gh pr create`, `github-actions[bot]` immediately pushes a `chore(release)` commit to the PR branch — the next local push is rejected until you `git fetch` + rebase onto it.
The winfsp FUSE path (`crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/`) cannot be compiled on macOS; CI is the sole compile-check backstop for those edits.
The repo codebase is not rustfmt-styled; running `cargo fmt` would reformat the entire tree. No `cargo fmt` or `clippy` CI gate exists.
codecov `patch` and `desktop` flags are both `informational: true` (codecov.yml:62,69) — the ❌ patch coverage report does not block merge.

The existing `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` job already produces coverage for all Rust crates, but the `desktop` flag path filter (`apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**`) discards the crate lines, making the 40 fuse + 43 sdk tests invisible to codecov.
All 75 codecov-missing lines in the PR are in `apps/desktop/src-tauri/` Tauri glue (mount orchestration, command wiring, tray renders) — inherently untestable by unit tests.
`tray/status.rs` is already at 100% coverage as a proof-of-pattern: pure status mapping separated from OS calls is testable; OS/FUSE/Tauri glue is not.
Phase 42 commits appear in the phase-43 branch's commit list (branch predates the #485 squash-merge) but contribute zero net diff against `origin/main` — squash-merge collapses the noise cleanly.
The `crates/sdk` codecov flag at 84.62% refers to the TypeScript `packages/sdk`, not the Rust crate.

code.finding: CR-03 (major): mkdir path journaled `encrypted_ipns_for_tee` (TEE-wrapped key) into the user-key field via `.unwrap_or_else(|_| encrypted_ipns_for_tee.clone().unwrap_or_default())`. Fixed to warn + journal empty string so replay parks rather than silently writing the wrong key.
CR-03 (minor): same TEE-key fallback as windows/write_ops.rs. Both sites fixed identically.
Parent IPNS key wrap failure swallowed via `.ok()` → empty key, breaks replay publish. Hardened to warn-on-failure like the other IPNS key wrap sites.

CR-04: in-memory mutations (inode.kind at ~765, pending_content at ~782, queue_publish at ~794) fired before `journal.put`. Reordered so all mutations occur only after the journal fsync commits — prepare failure now mutates nothing, eliminating the phantom-publish risk.

Case-sensitive `"not found"` string match for replay first-publish detection. Applied `.to_lowercase()` as a CodeRabbit minor; a typed Result<Option<u64>> from resolve_sequence is the proper fix (deferred as todo).
Duplicated per-variant `sort_by_key` match. Fixed by adding a `JournalOp::created_at_ms()` accessor and collapsing the sort to a single call.
Dead `journal_entry_id` field in fuser `UploadSpawnParams` — populated, destructured, then only `let _`-suppressed. Removed entirely.

Edge-trigger notify logic (notify only when failed > prev, reset on Idle) was inline and untested. Extracted into pure `bridge_status(prev, current)` function; 8 unit tests added covering spam-regression and state-transition cases.

`cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` called at lines 148/152/886 while the rest of the file uses `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key`. Normalized to `ecies::wrap_key` (same function, cosmetic consistency fix).

workflow: When 1Password SSH signing fails with 'failed to fill whole buffer', quit and reopen the 1Password app to recover the signer — staged files are preserved, only the signing step needs to retry.
CodeRabbit CLI review can be scoped to a branch's merge-base diff (`--from-sha <merge-base>`) to avoid reviewing phase N-1 code already merged to main.
Parallel verification agents (one per review finding) are an efficient pattern for cross-checking whether documented criticals are still live in code vs. already fixed by later commits.
Commit messages claiming a fix (e.g., 'close CR-04/08/07') cannot be trusted at face value — live code verification is required before marking findings resolved.
For the bot-commit push rejection after `gh pr create`: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/<branch>` then re-push is the clean recovery.
When PR diff appears to contain commits from a previously merged phase (pre-squash branch): compare against `origin/main`, not local `main`, to get the true net diff.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed twice ('failed to fill whole buffer') mid-session, requiring app restart and commit retries each time.
GitHub connectivity timed out (75s) on the first push attempt after PR creation.
`gh pr create` triggers an immediate bot `chore(release)` commit that causes the next push to be rejected — required discovering this pattern mid-flow and rebasing.
winfsp edits are unverifiable locally on macOS; all confidence in those changes is based on structural symmetry with the compile-tested fuser path.
The `cargo check` call for the winfsp CI path had to be tracked via a background task + file poll rather than inline output, adding round-trip latency.
open_items: CI winfsp compile gate (first real compile of the CR-03/CR-04/simplify winfsp edits) — watch the 'Lint' and 'Verify E2E' checks on PR #487.

[refactor, highest priority] Consolidate duplicated fuser↔winfsp upload + mkdir journal-entry construction (~150 lines, already drifting) into shared CipherBoxFS methods in crates/fuse/src/lib.rs. Security-sensitive: D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved.

[refactor] Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with `Option<String>` uniformly + a `wrap_ipns_key_for_journal` helper. ~5 producer sites + 3 replay decoder sites currently inconsistent (parent uses sentinel, file already uses Option).

[refactor] Extract shared journal-dir path + DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES constant triplicated across fuse/mod.rs, fuse/windows/mod.rs, and commands/sync.rs. CR-07 footgun: sync daemon and FUSE mount must point at identical directory.

[refactor] Have `replay_upload_entry` delegate to `operations::publish_file_metadata` and extract a shared `cas_publish_parent` helper (currently 3rd copy of ~110 lines also in write_ops.rs and windows/write_ops.rs).

[perf] Memoize `resolve_folder_key` during `replay_for_vault` — currently re-walks vault tree from root for every replayed entry; mount-time replay latency is super-linear with queued entries sharing a parent.

[refactor] Replace `e.to_lowercase().contains("not found")` branch key in replay first-publish detection with a typed `Result<Option<u64>>` from `resolve_sequence`. Touches PublishCoordinator and all callers.
No unit test asserting CR-04 behavior: 'prepare failure leaves in-memory state unmutated.' Existing replay/park tests pass but the invariant is only proven by code inspection.
Rust crate codecov wiring (ci.yml + codecov.yml edits) was still being committed/pushed at end of session — confirm those commits landed and the next codecov run picks up crate coverage.
